summary: Added oracle/Bzip2/Oracle/Compress/Huffman.lean (choose, makeCodeLengths, assignCodes, numTables; follows sendMTFValues/huffman.c incl. heap tie order and weight-scaling retry), imported from Oracle.lean. Tests in tests/Bzip2/Tests.lean compare lengths, codes, selectors, nGroups for 7 real blocks (2..6 tables) and 8 hbMakeCodeLengths cases (incl. scaling retry) against vectors in tests/vectors/huffman dumped from an out-of-tree instrumented build of upstream. verify.sh passes.
followups: Selector MTF (selectorMtf) and writing tables to the bitstream are left to later compress tasks.
Test vectors are only for level-1 single blocks; the generator driver is not committed (lived in /tmp).
